adjusted_price_basis: TDX_NATIVE_AFFINE_QFQ; category 1 only; no BaoStock adjusted prices

period_rules.open: first valid actual daily open by trade date
period_rules.close: last valid actual daily close by trade date
period_rules.volume_amount: sum valid actual daily source-native values
period_rules.no_actual_bars: null OHLC; never synthesize zero prices
period_rules.closed_only: period_last_session <= T0 and active-membership sessions fully accounted without DATA_GAP, UNKNOWN, or invalid actual bars
period_rules.as_of_partial: aggregate actual bars through T0 only when period continues beyond T0
period_rules.qfq_unready: null QFQ OHLC; BLOCKED_BY_ADJUSTMENT; never fall back to RAW
